name: tutorial_ns
descriptor:
nsd:
  nsd:
  - description: Simple NS with one VNF and a single Virtual Link
    df:
    - id: default-df
      vnf-profile:
      - id: "vnf1"
        virtual-link-connectivity:
        - constituent-cpd-id:
          - constituent-base-element-id: "1"
            constituent-cpd-id: vnf-vdu1-ext # this must be equal to the vdu's ext-cpd's id 
          virtual-link-profile-id: mgmtnet_2
        - constituent-cpd-id:
          - constituent-base-element-id: "1"
            constituent-cpd-id: vnf-vdu2-ext # this must be equal to the vdu's ext-cpd's id 
          virtual-link-profile-id: mgmtnet_2
        vnfd-id: tutorial_vnf
      - id: "vnf2"
        virtual-link-connectivity:
        - constituent-cpd-id:
          - constituent-base-element-id: "1"
            constituent-cpd-id: vnf-vdu1-ext # this must be equal to the vdu's ext-cpd's id 
          virtual-link-profile-id: mgmtnet_2
        - constituent-cpd-id:
          - constituent-base-element-id: "1"
            constituent-cpd-id: vnf-vdu2-ext # this must be equal to the vdu's ext-cpd's id 
          virtual-link-profile-id: mgmtnet_2
        vnfd-id: tutorial_vnf
    id: tutorial_ns
    name: tutorial_ns
    version: "1.0"
    virtual-link-desc:
    - id: mgmtnet_2
      mgmt-network: true
      vim-network-name: new_5gasp
    vnfd-id:
    - tutorial_vnf

vxfref.name: tutorial_vnf
vxfref.descriptor:
vnfd:
  description: A basic VNF descriptor with two VDUs
  mgmt-cp: vnf-vdu1-ext
  int-virtual-link-desc:
  - id: internal-vl
    flavour:
    - id: internal-vl-flavor
  product-name: tutorial_vnf
  id: tutorial_vnf
  df:
  - id: default-df
    instantiation-level:
    - id: default-instantiation-level
      vdu-level:
      - number-of-instances: "1"
        vdu-id: vdu1
      - number-of-instances: "1"
        vdu-id: vdu2
    vdu-profile:
    - id: vdu1
      min-number-of-instances: "1"
    - id: vdu2
      min-number-of-instances: "1"
    # Juju/LCM Actions
    lcm-operations-configuration:
      operate-vnf-op-config:
        day1-2:
        - execution-environment-list:
          - id: configure-vnf
            external-connection-point-ref: vnf-vdu1-ext
            juju:
              charm: simple-touch
              proxy: true
          id: tutorial_vnf
          config-access:
            ssh-access:
              default-user: ubuntu
              required: true
          initial-config-primitive:
          - execution-environment-ref: configure-vnf
            name: config
            parameter:
            - name: ssh-hostname
              value: <rw_mgmt_ip>
            - name: ssh-username
              value: ubuntu
            - name: ssh-password
              value: tutorial
            seq: 1
          config-primitive:
          - name: run-touch-command
            execution-environment-ref: configure-vnf
            parameter:
              - name: filename
                data-type: STRING
        #####################################
        - execution-environment-list:
          - id: vdu1-ee
            external-connection-point-ref: vnf-vdu1-ext
            juju:
              charm: simple-touch
              proxy: true
          id: vdu1 # this must be equal to the vdu's id
          config-access:
            ssh-access:
              default-user: ubuntu
              required: true
          initial-config-primitive:
          - execution-environment-ref: vdu1-ee
            name: config
            parameter:
            - name: ssh-hostname
              value: <rw_mgmt_ip>
            - name: ssh-username
              value: ubuntu
            - name: ssh-password
              value: tutorial
            seq: 1
          config-primitive:
          - name: run-touch-command
            execution-environment-ref: vdu1-ee
            parameter:
              - name: filename
                data-type: STRING
        - execution-environment-list:
          - id: vdu2-ee
            #external-connection-point-ref: vnf-cp2-ext
            juju:
              charm: simple-touch
              proxy: true
          id: vdu2 # this must be equal to the vdu's id
          config-access:
            ssh-access:
              default-user: ubuntu
              required: true
          initial-config-primitive:
          - execution-environment-ref: vdu2-ee
            name: config
            parameter:
            - name: ssh-hostname
              value: <rw_mgmt_ip>
            - name: ssh-username
              value: ubuntu
            - name: ssh-password
              value: tutorial
            seq: 1
          config-primitive:
          - name: run-touch-command
            execution-environment-ref: vdu2-ee
            parameter:
              - name: filename
                data-type: STRING
  ext-cpd:
  - id: vnf-vdu1-ext
    int-cpd:
      cpd: vdu1-int-out
      vdu-id: vdu1
  - id: vnf-vdu2-ext
    int-cpd:
      cpd: vdu2-int-out
      vdu-id: vdu2
  sw-image-desc:
  - id: "ubuntu-20.04-server-cloudimg-amd64"
    image: "ubuntu-20.04-server-cloudimg-amd64"
    name: "ubuntu-20.04-server-cloudimg-amd64"
  vdu:
  - cloud-init-file: cloud-config.txt
    id: vdu1
    int-cpd:
    - id: vdu1-int-out
      virtual-network-interface-requirement:
      - name: vdu1-out
        virtual-interface:
          type: PARAVIRT
    - id: vdu1-int-in
      int-virtual-link-desc: internal-vl
      virtual-network-interface-requirement:
      - name: vdu1-in
        virtual-interface:
          type: PARAVIRT
    name: vdu1
    sw-image-desc: "ubuntu-20.04-server-cloudimg-amd64"
    virtual-compute-desc: vdu1-compute
    virtual-storage-desc:
    - vdu1-storage
  - cloud-init-file: cloud-config.txt
    id: vdu2
    int-cpd:
    - id: vdu2-int-out
      virtual-network-interface-requirement:
      - name: vdu2-out
        virtual-interface:
          type: PARAVIRT
    - id: vdu2-int-in
      int-virtual-link-desc: internal-vl
      virtual-network-interface-requirement:
      - name: vdu2-in
        virtual-interface:
          type: PARAVIRT
    name: vdu2
    sw-image-desc: "ubuntu-20.04-server-cloudimg-amd64"
    virtual-compute-desc: vdu2-compute
    virtual-storage-desc:
    - vdu2-storage
  version: "1.0"
  virtual-compute-desc:
  - id: vdu1-compute
    virtual-cpu:
      num-virtual-cpu: "1"
    virtual-memory:
      size: "1.0"
  - id: vdu2-compute
    virtual-cpu:
      num-virtual-cpu: "1"
    virtual-memory:
      size: "1.0"
  virtual-storage-desc:
  - id: vdu1-storage
    size-of-storage: "10"
  - id: vdu2-storage
    size-of-storage: "10"
